verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own openAPI() plugin generates an OpenAPI 3.1.1 schema covering core and plugin endpoints. The schema is retrievable as JSON via auth.api.generateOpenAPISchema() or the /api/auth/open-api/generate-schema endpoint, and a Scalar reference is also served. However, the vendor labels the plugin early-stage, and the spec exists only on the integrator's own deployment; the vendor-hosted openapi.json paths all returned 404. missing for 10: stable (non-early-stage) status of the OpenAPI plugin, a vendor-hosted downloadable spec, independent or hands-on corroboration that the generated schema is complete and accurate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
